meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简报，一步步做成一段产品发布/宣传视频。它会先抓取网页素材和品牌信息，再规划分镜与脚本，逐帧生成画面并最终渲染出 MP4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想给产品做宣传/发布，或为商业网址做推广视频，或做网站导览/展示时，Claude 会接管并启动视频制作流程。

say.text: 把这个产品的落地页做成一条发布宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会抓取页面并开始分镜脚本流程。

say.text: 这是我们新功能的介绍脚本，帮我做成视频。
say.note: 它会按脚本内容规划分镜并生成视频。

say.text: 给我们的网站做一个展示视频。
say.note: 网站导览/展示需求会走这个技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch/promo video. It captures web assets and brand signals, plans storyboard and script, generates frames, and renders a final MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, make a promo for a commercial URL, or do a site tour/showcase. If unsure, it routes to /hyperframes instead.

say_en.text: Turn this product landing page into a launch promo video.
say_en.note: Claude captures the page and starts storyboard/script flow.

say_en.text: Here's our feature intro script; make a video from it.
say_en.note: It plans the storyboard from the script and generates video.

say_en.text: Make a showcase video for our website.
say_en.note: Site tour/showcase requests route through this skill.
